summary.intent: Manage the GSD (Get Stuff Done) workflow for CipherBox Phase 72 (SDK write-plane durability/correctness): assess whether it needed discussion, reconcile todo drift from phases 70/70.1/71, then plan, execute, verify, and ship the phase — while also triaging and fixing unrelated CI regressions and flakiness discovered along the way.
summary.outcome: Phase 72 was fully planned (research + pattern-mapping + 10-plan/7-wave plan), executed with TDD across all waves, hardened (fixed 113 pre-existing test-file TS errors, wired test-inclusive typecheck into CI, found and fixed a real DoS-class unbounded-recursion bug), verified (goal-backward PASS), and carried through most of ship-phase (verify/secure/simplify/SDK-E2E-gate/CodeRabbit CLI/commit reword) with the branch pushed; two prior CI regressions (web-e2e floor store, desktop-e2e FUSE seq-1 equivocation) were also root-caused and merged via PRs #600/#601 before Phase 72 resumed.

repo: GSD todos flow pending/ -> completed/; Phase 71 shipped (#599) without retiring its 8 source todos, leaving them stale in pending/ — a recurring drift pattern worth checking after every phase ship.

ci-e2e.yml (Web E2E + Desktop E2E) triggers ONLY on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch, never on pull_request — must dispatch manually via `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>` (not `-f ref=`, which 422s on workflows predating that input) to validate before merge.
sdk-e2e runs on pull_request via ci.yml, unlike the other e2e suites.

vitest does not load .env — sdk-e2e/API secrets must be exported into process.env manually or tests silently fall back to a hardcoded default secret, producing 401s that look like environment corruption.

Playwright's `ciFloor()` helper only raises wait timeouts to 60s under CI; local runs keep the lower default, so local verification can flake on ambient IPNS latency for tests that are stable in CI, and vice versa — the only faithful local check is running with CI=1 plus a temporary `reuseExistingServer` patch.

Root `pnpm typecheck` only runs each package's `tsconfig.build.json` (excludes tests) — test files were never typechecked in CI, allowing 113 errors (vitest v2->v3 Mock generics drift + Phase-62 retired-type fallout) to accumulate silently.

`@cipherbox/*` packages resolve via workspace symlinks to built `dist` (no path aliases/project references), so a test-inclusive typecheck must run per-package after that package's build, in dependency order.

Phase 71 renamed share DTO fields (readDescriptorRef->encryptedReadKey, writeDescriptorRef->encryptedWriteKey, rootIpnsName->shareRootIpnsName) but left the desktop-e2e `.mts` test driver on the old names, causing a 400 from `forbidNonWhitelisted` validation.

GSD executor commits use non-conventional subjects (e.g. `feat 51-03:`, `refactor sdk:`) that fail the `pr-release-preview`/commitlint gate — must reword via `git filter-branch --msg-filter` (rebase -i unavailable) before opening a PR.
A stale built API `dist` silently rejects `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` even when `.env` matches on disk — must restart the API from source to pick up current secrets.

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on the first-publish branch; a dropped/stale UploadComplete re-running it collided with Phase 71's anti-equivocation gate. Fixed by resolving IPNS first and routing Found into the existing CAS-retry path instead of blindly re-sealing at seq=1.

publish_with_cas_retry gained an optional preresolved_seq param so a caller that already resolved the sequence (the Found path) skips a redundant second resolve; conflict-retry still re-resolves since a pre-resolved value is stale after conflict.

collectDescendantIpnsNames had no cycle guard (unlike sibling dfsFindFolder's visited Set), enabling unbounded recursion / DoS on a cyclic or malicious folder graph — found while enabling a skipped test during Phase 72 hardening, fixed by threading the same visited-set pattern, and covered by a new cyclic A->B->A regression test.
Test driver used stale pre-Phase-71 DTO field names, causing false-positive-looking 400s that masked confirmation the real FUSE fix had worked.

workflow: When a CI dispatch workflow fails on multiple OSes after a fix, check whether the equivocation/error signature itself is gone from logs before assuming the fix failed — a different downstream error can mean the original bug is fixed but a second, unrelated issue is now exposed.

For local verification of flaky e2e chains, distinguishing 'real CI regression' from 'ambient local timing/load artifact' required running under the CI-equivalent timeout regime (CI=1) rather than repeatedly re-running under local defaults, which just relocates which test flakes.

When triaging AskUserQuestion-driven decisions during autonomous execution (e.g. retries:0 vs source-fixes), captured user's philosophy explicitly so downstream related decisions (leaving a local-only cold-stack test flake unchanged) stayed consistent without re-asking.

Deferred, hard-to-parse structured data (hook JSON with raw control chars) is often not worth fighting — falling back to authoring an equivalent prompt directly (matching the target agent's known output contract) was faster and safer than forcing a parser.

Background/async task notifications combined with git-state checks (commit counts, diff, tree state) let long unattended CI-fire and phase-execution work proceed without blocking on user presence, consistent with the user's explicit autonomous-authorization directive.

friction: `gh workflow run -f ref=` returned HTTP 422 because main's workflow definition predated the `ref` input; had to switch to `--ref <branch>`.

Local full-workflow.spec.ts verification cascaded through multiple unrelated ambient flakes (4.10 batch delete, 4.11 batch move, 2.1 create-folder) across 5+ re-runs before reaching the actual target tests (6.6.2, 8.2), consuming significant iteration time.
CI=1 local run initially failed instantly because `reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI` refused to reuse the already-running stack — required a temporary, reverted playwright.config.ts patch.
Raw hook JSON fragments (plan:pre capabilities) contained literal control characters, breaking both `--raw` output and a first parsing attempt; needed a custom lenient parser script.
A `git cat-file`-based check of HEAD tree contents initially gave inconsistent results, causing a temporary false alarm that todo moves weren't committed correctly.
lint-staged / commit hung at the 2-minute timeout due to a known 1Password SSH-signing prompt issue, producing a false-negative on whether the commit landed (had to verify via `git log`).

sdk-e2e write-plane suites failed twice with 401 'Invalid test login secret' — first due to a stale API dist, then (after restart) because vitest doesn't load .env and required SDK_E2E_SECRET to be explicitly exported.
